_comment: Known-broken showcase programs the compile-floor tolerates, each tracked under a filed gap. A baselined program does NOT fail the floor; a NEW break does. The floor ALSO fails if a baselined entry starts compiling (or is no longer enumerated) — prune it then. Add an entry ONLY for a genuinely-tracked bug; remove it the moment the fix or example-rewrite lands. See scripts/corpus-compile-floor.ts.
